prompt: Close at a brazier made from a cut-down steel drum at dusk: the hands of five adults held out to the flames, a grey-stubbled man in a supermarket uniform fleece, a woman with a hospital lanyard still round her neck, behind them out of focus a field of tents. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
